guidance_summary:
GUIDANCE ANALYSIS: Analog Devices — Q1 2026

METRIC: Revenue
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: $3.5 billion, +/- $100 million.
UNIT: USD
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Fiscal Q2 2026
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Quarter
BASIS: Reported/company revenue outlook; no organic or constant-currency basis stated.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- Strong execution against cyclical and secular growth tailwinds.
- Broad industrial strength and record data-center orders.
- Macro and geopolitical backdrop remains challenging.

METRIC: Revenue growth
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: About 11% sequential growth at the midpoint; excluding pricing uplift, sequential growth is more like 7%, versus typical seasonality of 4% to 5%.
UNIT: sequential growth
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Fiscal Q2 2026
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Quarter
BASIS: Company revenue outlook at midpoint; reported basis not otherwise specified.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- Pricing actions contribute about one-third of the midpoint quarter-over-quarter revenue increase.
- Underlying growth excluding pricing remains above typical seasonal growth.

METRIC: Reported operating margin
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: Approximately 36.4%, +/- 150 bps, at the revenue-outlook midpoint.
UNIT: percent
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Fiscal Q2 2026
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Quarter
BASIS: Reported (GAAP), at the midpoint of the revenue outlook.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- Higher revenue volume and favorable business conditions embedded in the Q2 outlook.

METRIC: Adjusted operating margin
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: Approximately 47.5%, +/- 100 bps, at the revenue-outlook midpoint; about 200 bps of sequential improvement.
UNIT: percent
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Fiscal Q2 2026
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Quarter
BASIS: Adjusted (non-GAAP), at the midpoint of the revenue outlook.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- Expected gross-margin expansion and operating leverage.
- Operating expenses are expected to rise but decline as a percentage of revenue.

METRIC: Reported EPS
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: $2.19, +/- $0.15.
UNIT: USD per diluted share
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Fiscal Q2 2026
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Quarter
BASIS: Reported (GAAP).
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- Based on the company's Q2 revenue, margin, and tax assumptions.

METRIC: Adjusted EPS
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: $2.88, +/- $0.15.
UNIT: USD per diluted share
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Fiscal Q2 2026
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Quarter
BASIS: Adjusted (non-GAAP).
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- Based on the company's Q2 revenue, adjusted operating-margin, and tax assumptions.

METRIC: Tax rate
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: Between 11% and 13%.
UNIT: percent
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Fiscal Q2 2026
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Quarter
BASIS: Non-GAAP tax-rate outlook, consistent with management's call convention that tax-rate comments are non-GAAP.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- Embedded in management's Q2 earnings-model outlook.

METRIC: Adjusted gross-margin expansion
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: Assumes 100 basis points of gross-margin expansion in Q2; approximately 150 basis points higher versus Q1 excluding Q1 discrete items.
UNIT: basis points
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Fiscal Q2 2026
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Quarter
BASIS: Non-GAAP gross-margin outlook.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- Favorable product mix.
- Price uplift.
- Utilization is nearing optimal levels, so management expects only modest further upside from utilization.

METRIC: Adjusted gross-margin benefit from channel-inventory repricing
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: Includes 50 basis points related to the one-time effect of repricing inventory in the channel.
UNIT: basis points
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Fiscal Q2 2026
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Quarter
BASIS: Non-GAAP gross-margin bridge.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- One-time channel-inventory repricing resulting from pricing actions.

METRIC: Adjusted gross-margin benefit from channel-inventory repricing
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: The 50 basis points of channel-inventory repricing benefit will not recur.
UNIT: basis points
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Fiscal Q3 2026
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Quarter
BASIS: Non-GAAP gross-margin outlook; describes the absence of a prior-quarter one-time benefit.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- The Q2 benefit relates to one-time repricing of inventory already in the channel.

METRIC: Operating-expense growth
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: Grow in the mid-single-digit range.
UNIT: growth rate
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Fiscal Q2 2026
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Quarter
BASIS: Non-GAAP operating-expense outlook.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- No shutdown in Q2.
- Continued hiring in strategic investment areas.
- Higher bonus factor and GTC conference costs.

METRIC: Operating-expense growth relative to revenue growth
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: OpEx growth is expected to trail revenue growth by roughly half.
UNIT: relative growth relationship
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Fiscal 2026
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Full Year
BASIS: Non-GAAP operating-expense outlook.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- Management expects operating leverage as revenue grows.

METRIC: Industrial revenue growth
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: Up 20% sequentially and about 50% year over year; all industrial segments are expected to increase.
UNIT: growth rate
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Fiscal Q2 2026
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Quarter
BASIS: End-market revenue outlook; reported basis not otherwise specified.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- Cyclical recovery.
- Strength in automated test equipment (ATE) and aerospace and defense.
- Broad-based strength across industrial segments, regions, and applications.

METRIC: ATE revenue growth
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: Greater than 30% sequential growth.
UNIT: sequential growth rate
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Fiscal Q2 2026
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Quarter
BASIS: Industrial-subsegment revenue outlook; reported basis not otherwise specified.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- ATE is expected to lead industrial growth.
- Demand and investment tied to semiconductor complexity and AI-related test requirements.

METRIC: Communications revenue growth
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: Up high single digits sequentially and about 60% year over year.
UNIT: growth rate
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Fiscal Q2 2026
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Quarter
BASIS: End-market revenue outlook; reported basis not otherwise specified.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- AI-driven data-center surge for optical and power portfolios.
- Wireless cyclical recovery.

METRIC: Automotive revenue growth
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: Flat to down sequentially, below seasonal.
UNIT: sequential growth rate
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Fiscal Q2 2026
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Quarter
BASIS: End-market revenue outlook; reported basis not otherwise specified.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- Tariff- and macro-related pull-in unwind.
- Softer bookings and greater China exposure, where Q2 is typically lighter because of Chinese New Year.

METRIC: Consumer revenue growth
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: Down mid-single digits sequentially, in line with seasonality.
UNIT: sequential growth rate
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Fiscal Q2 2026
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Quarter
BASIS: End-market revenue outlook; reported basis not otherwise specified.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- Normal seasonal demand pattern.

METRIC: Automotive revenue growth
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: Automotive will grow in fiscal 2026 versus the record fiscal 2025.
UNIT: year-over-year growth
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Fiscal 2026
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Full Year
BASIS: End-market revenue outlook; qualitative.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- Management expects first-half headwinds to pass and the second half to be stronger.
- Underlying content growth and share position in connectivity, power, and Level 2+ ADAS remain intact.

METRIC: Capital expenditures
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: Within the long-term model of 4% to 6% of revenue.
UNIT: percent of revenue
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Fiscal 2026
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Full Year
BASIS: Capital-expenditure outlook.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- Capital spending will support operations and strategic investments while remaining within the company's long-term model.

METRIC: Pricing contribution to revenue growth
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: About one-third of the Q2 quarter-over-quarter revenue increase at the midpoint is related to price; roughly half of the price lift relates to channel-inventory repricing.
UNIT: share of quarter-over-quarter revenue increase
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Fiscal Q2 2026
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Quarter
BASIS: Sequential revenue-growth contribution from pricing at the revenue-outlook midpoint.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- Recent pricing actions with channel partners and direct customers.
- Channel-inventory repricing accounts for roughly half of the Q2 price lift.

METRIC: Pricing contribution to revenue growth
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: About 50 basis points of incremental growth related to price.
UNIT: basis points of incremental revenue growth
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Fiscal Q3 2026
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Quarter
BASIS: Sequential revenue-growth contribution from pricing.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- Ongoing pricing actions, excluding the Q2 channel-inventory repricing benefit that does not repeat.

METRIC: Pricing contribution to revenue growth
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: About 50 basis points of incremental growth related to price.
UNIT: basis points of incremental revenue growth
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Fiscal Q4 2026
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Quarter
BASIS: Sequential revenue-growth contribution from pricing.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- Ongoing pricing actions.

METRIC: Data-center and ATE growth
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: These areas will all grow at double digits over the next several years.
UNIT: growth rate
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Over the next several years
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Multi Year
BASIS: Qualitative long-term growth outlook for ATE, data-center power, and data-center optical-related areas.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- AI infrastructure investment and data-center architectural change.
- Increasing semiconductor complexity supports ATE demand.
- Power-delivery, power-control, and optical-connectivity content growth.

METRIC: Free-cash-flow return to shareholders
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: Target 100% free cash flow return over the long term.
UNIT: percent of free cash flow
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Over the long term
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Multi Year
BASIS: Capital-allocation target.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- Management's shareholder-return framework uses dividends and share-count reduction.

METRIC: Dividend allocation of free cash flow
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: Use 40% to 60% of free cash flow for the dividend, with the remainder for share-count reduction.
UNIT: percent of free cash flow
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: Over the long term
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Multi Year
BASIS: Capital-allocation target.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- Part of the company's targeted 100% long-term free-cash-flow return to shareholders.

METRIC: Quarterly cash dividend
PROJECTION/GUIDANCE: $1.10 per outstanding share; expected to total approximately $537.0 million.
UNIT: USD per share
TIMEFRAME/TARGET PERIOD: March 17, 2026 payment date
TIMEFRAME SCOPE: Date Range
BASIS: Declared quarterly cash dividend.
MAIN RATIONALE/DRIVERS:
- Board declared the dividend following an 11% increase.
- Payable to shareholders of record at the close of business on March 3, 2026.

events.title: Analog Devices Strengthens Global Manufacturing Resilience with New Thailand Facility
events.summary: Analog Devices announced the opening of an advanced manufacturing facility in Chonburi, Thailand. The site expands manufacturing and test capacity for wafer-level processing, chip-scale packaging and final IC test, serving industrial, automotive, communications, consumer and healthcare markets. ADI described the expansion as part of its hybrid internal-factory, foundry and OSAT manufacturing strategy.
source_headlines: Analog Devices Strengthens Global Manufacturing Resilience with New Thailand Facility

events.title: Analog Devices to Acquire Empower Semiconductor, Expanding its Next-Generation High-Density Power Portfolio for the AI Era
events.summary: Analog Devices and Empower Semiconductor entered a definitive agreement under which ADI will acquire Empower for $1.5 billion in cash. Empower's silicon capacitors are already in production, and its integrated-voltage-regulator programs are advancing with leading hyperscalers and AI-silicon providers. The transaction is expected to close in the second half of calendar 2026, subject to customary closing conditions and Hart-Scott-Rodino review.
source_headlines: Analog Devices to Acquire Empower Semiconductor, Expanding its Next-Generation High-Density Power Portfolio for the AI Era

metric_impacts.metric_total_calculation: Target basis: standalone fiscal Q2 2026 (three months ending May 2, 2026), reported revenue, USDm. Previous reported standalone fiscal Q1 2026 revenue = $3,160m. Management's explicit Q2 midpoint revenue outlook = $3,500m, so no FY-to-quarter interpolation is needed. Total change = GUIDANCE + E1 + E2 = ($3,500m - $3,160m) + $0m + $0m = +$340m.

event_contributions.affected_line: Sales volume, selling price, and end-market/product mix.
event_contributions.transmission_path: Higher industrial, ATE, communications/data-center demand and pricing lift increase revenue directly: Revenue = units shipped × realized ASP. The higher revenue base then provides operating leverage, but the Revenue metric impact stops at the top line.
assumptions: Management's Q2 midpoint of $3,500m is the central forecast rather than either end of the +/- $100m range.
The prior reported actual supplied for Q1 2026 is $3,160m.
This is explicit standalone-quarter guidance for fiscal Q2, not FY guidance; therefore, no annual phasing or pro-rating is applied.
event_contributions.calculation: DISCRETE/TIMED ROUTE for the guided quarter: Q2 revenue forecast = $3,500m. Change versus Q1 actual = $3,500m - $3,160m = +$340m. This incorporates management's stated above-seasonal underlying growth plus the Q2 pricing contribution; it is not separately added again in news-event calculations.

event_contributions.affected_line: Production capacity, production cost/capex, and potential future sales volume.
event_contributions.transmission_path: The Thailand facility could eventually expand available manufacturing and test capacity: capacity availability → potential future shipments → revenue. However, no incremental Q2 shipment, utilization, selling-price, or capacity-ramp amount was disclosed; therefore incremental Q2 recognized revenue is zero.
assumptions: The March 19, 2026 announcement occurred within fiscal Q2, but it described a capacity/resilience expansion rather than a quantified Q2 production ramp or customer shipment program.
Management had already issued a specific Q2 revenue guide on February 18, 2026, and the later release did not revise that outlook.

To prevent double counting, any capacity available to support the guided Q2 demand is treated as embedded in the existing operating plan; only incremental, measurable capacity-driven sales would be added, and none were disclosed.
event_contributions.calculation: ANNUAL/RUN-RATE ROUTE assessed, but no quantified annual or Q2 revenue effect exists. Q2 incremental revenue = incremental Q2 units disclosed (0) × realized ASP = $0m. Narrative change: little for Q2; potentially meaningful only for longer-term resilience/capacity.

event_contributions.affected_line: Acquired-business sales/consolidation timing and transaction closing.
event_contributions.transmission_path: A consolidated revenue effect requires acquisition closing and post-close consolidation: acquisition close → consolidate Empower sales → ADI revenue. The announced closing window was second-half calendar 2026, while fiscal Q2 ended May 2, 2026; hence there can be no Q2 consolidation effect.
assumptions: The transaction was announced May 19, 2026, after the fiscal Q2 2026 period ended May 2, 2026.
The transaction was expected to close in the second half of calendar 2026, subject to conditions; no Empower revenue amount or Q2 contribution was disclosed.
Potential strategic revenue synergies are long-term and are not recognized in Q2 revenue before closing.
event_contributions.calculation: DISCRETE/TIMED ROUTE: Q2 consolidation window ended May 2, 2026, before the May 19 announcement and before the anticipated second-half-calendar-2026 close. Q2 acquired revenue = $0m; incremental Q2 revenue impact = $0m. Narrative change: no change to the Q2 guide.

metric_impacts.metric_total_calculation: Target basis: standalone fiscal Q2 2026 adjusted/non-GAAP diluted EPS. Previous reported fiscal Q1 2026 adjusted diluted EPS = $2.46. Management's explicit fiscal Q2 adjusted diluted EPS outlook at the revenue midpoint = $2.88. Total change = GUIDANCE + E1 + E2 = ($2.88 - $2.46) + $0.00 + $0.00 = +$0.42 per diluted share.

event_contributions.affected_line: Sales volume, selling price, product mix, production cost, operating expenses, tax, and diluted share count.
event_contributions.transmission_path: Demand, price, and favorable mix raise adjusted gross profit; gross-profit expansion and revenue growth exceeding expected OpEx growth raise adjusted operating income; after adjusted non-operating expense and the guided non-GAAP tax rate, adjusted net income divided by diluted shares produces adjusted diluted EPS.
assumptions: Management's directly guided adjusted diluted EPS of $2.88 is used as the central Q2 outcome.
The Q2 tax-rate planning range of 11%-13% and the guided adjusted operating margin are embedded in the EPS outlook.
No separate EPS uplift is calculated from revenue guidance because management's $2.88 adjusted-EPS guidance already captures revenue, margin, operating expense, tax, and share-count assumptions.
event_contributions.calculation: Q2 adjusted diluted EPS forecast = $2.88 per share. Δ adjusted EPS = Q2 guided adjusted EPS - Q1 reported adjusted EPS = $2.88 - $2.46 = +$0.42 per share. Financial-statement identity: Adjusted EPS = [(Revenue - adjusted COGS - adjusted OpEx - adjusted net interest/other) × (1 - adjusted tax rate)] / diluted weighted-average shares.

event_contributions.affected_line: Production cost, depreciation, capex, and potential future factory utilization.
event_contributions.transmission_path: A new facility can ultimately affect cost of sales through utilization, depreciation, labor, and logistics, then adjusted operating income and EPS. No incremental Q2 depreciation, utilization, cost-savings, or production-volume amount was quantified.
assumptions: The facility announcement supplies no amount for Q2 cost of sales, depreciation, operating expense, or revenue.
Any normal operating effect required to deliver the pre-existing Q2 guide is not incrementally added.
Capital expenditure itself affects cash flow and PP&E rather than adjusted EPS at the time of spending; only depreciation or operating costs would affect EPS, and no Q2 amount is disclosed.
event_contributions.calculation: DISCRETE/TIMED ROUTE: incremental Q2 adjusted pre-tax income = $0m because neither an incremental Q2 gross-profit nor cost amount is measurable. Incremental adjusted EPS = [$0m × (1 - assumed tax rate)] / diluted shares = $0.00 per share. Narrative change: little for Q2.

event_contributions.affected_line: Transaction and integration expense, acquired operating income, interest expense, tax, and diluted shares.
event_contributions.transmission_path: A transaction could affect EPS through post-close acquired earnings, financing/interest effects, integration expense, and acquisition-related amortization. However, fiscal Q2 ended before the deal was announced and before the expected second-half-calendar-2026 closing. In addition, ADI's adjusted EPS definition excludes acquisition-related expenses, reducing relevance of such costs to this adjusted metric.
assumptions: No transaction expense or financing change related to the May 19 announcement can be recognized in the fiscal quarter that ended May 2, 2026.
No acquired operations are consolidated before closing.
No quantified closing-date, financing, purchase-accounting, or deal-cost amount was disclosed for fiscal Q2.
event_contributions.calculation: DISCRETE/TIMED ROUTE: Q2 incremental adjusted net income = $0m because the announcement and expected closing occur after the May 2 fiscal-Q2 cutoff. Incremental adjusted EPS = $0m / diluted shares = $0.00 per share. Narrative change: no change to Q2 guidance.

metric_impacts.metric_total_calculation: Target basis: standalone fiscal Q2 2026 adjusted/non-GAAP gross-margin percentage. Previous reported fiscal Q1 2026 adjusted gross margin = 71.2%. Management indicated approximately 100 basis points of Q2 adjusted gross-margin expansion, including a 50-basis-point one-time channel-inventory repricing benefit. Total change = GUIDANCE + E1 + E2 = +1.0 percentage point + 0.0 percentage point + 0.0 percentage point = +1.0 percentage point, implying 72.2%.

event_contributions.affected_line: Selling price, product/end-market mix, production cost, and factory utilization.
event_contributions.transmission_path: Pricing and favorable mix increase revenue faster than adjusted cost of sales, while improved utilization lowers fixed-cost absorption per unit. Adjusted gross margin = (Revenue - adjusted COGS) / Revenue. Management specifically identified favorable mix, price uplift, and modest utilization upside, with a one-time channel-inventory repricing benefit.
assumptions: The guidance summary's approximately 100-basis-point sequential adjusted gross-margin expansion is applied to the reported Q1 adjusted gross margin of 71.2%.
The stated 50-basis-point channel-inventory repricing benefit is included within, not in addition to, the 100-basis-point Q2 expansion.
The measure is a margin rate; the projected change is expressed in percentage points, not percent growth.
event_contributions.calculation: Q2 adjusted gross-margin forecast = Q1 adjusted gross margin + guided expansion = 71.2% + 1.0 percentage point = 72.2%. Therefore Δ adjusted gross margin = 72.2% - 71.2% = +1.0 percentage point. Equation: adjusted GM% = (Revenue - adjusted COGS) / Revenue.

event_contributions.affected_line: Production cost, utilization, depreciation, and manufacturing yield.
event_contributions.transmission_path: The Thailand facility could affect adjusted COGS through yield, labor, logistics, factory utilization, and depreciation-related production cost, and thus adjusted gross margin. The announcement provides no Q2 cost, yield, utilization, or depreciation quantification.
assumptions: The facility is characterized as a long-term advanced manufacturing and test-capacity expansion, not as a quantified Q2 margin initiative.
Any manufacturing capability necessary to support management's Q2 volume and gross-margin outlook is treated as already included in GUIDANCE.
No incremental one-time qualification, start-up, yield, or depreciation effect on adjusted COGS was disclosed.
event_contributions.calculation: ANNUAL/RUN-RATE ROUTE assessed but cannot be quantified. Incremental Q2 adjusted gross-margin impact = incremental adjusted gross profit / Q2 revenue = $0m / $3,500m = 0.0 percentage point. Narrative change: little for Q2 and no defensible incremental margin adjustment.

event_contributions.affected_line: Acquired product mix, acquired COGS, purchase-accounting effects, and transaction closing.
event_contributions.transmission_path: After closing, Empower could alter consolidated mix and COGS, and purchase accounting could affect reported gross profit. But no acquired business can affect Q2 adjusted gross margin before closing; moreover the announcement was after the May 2 fiscal-Q2 period end.
assumptions: The transaction was announced on May 19, 2026, after fiscal Q2 ended May 2, 2026.
Closing was expected only in the second half of calendar 2026, and no purchase-accounting or acquired-margin estimate was disclosed.
Potential product-margin benefits are strategic post-close possibilities and are not recognized in fiscal Q2.
event_contributions.calculation: DISCRETE/TIMED ROUTE: Q2 incremental adjusted gross profit from Empower = $0m; Q2 revenue change from Empower = $0m. Incremental adjusted GM impact = (($0m adjusted gross profit effect) / $3,500m) = 0.0 percentage point. Narrative change: no Q2-guide change.
